sentences.zh: 这是两个独立的故事。

sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢。

sentences.en: Just a final question to you, since you've covered Fox for a really long time.
sentences.zh: 最后问你一个问题，因为你报道福克斯新闻已经很长一段时间了。

sentences.en: And not just for the New York Times, but in your previous job, were you surprised that this happened today?
sentences.zh: 不仅是为《纽约时报》，在你之前的工作中，你对今天发生的事情感到惊讶吗？

sentences.zh: 他是福克斯新闻最赚钱的招牌，是福克斯新闻的头号主持人，因此也是整个有线电视新闻界的头号人物。

sentences.en: You know, they have stood by him and supported him and protected him for a very long time.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们长期以来一直支持他、拥护他，并保护着他。

sentences.en: There's settlements related to his behavior going back to 2002.
sentences.zh: 与他行为相关的和解协议可以追溯到2002年。

sentences.zh: 他们以这种方式做出反应确实令人惊讶。

sentences.en: And therefore you are surprised.
sentences.zh: 所以你感到惊讶也是理所当然的。

sentences.en: I think I am.
sentences.zh: 我想是的。

sentences.en: It's a little surreal, I have to say.
sentences.zh: 不得不说，这有点超现实。

sentences.en: Emily, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 艾米丽，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·朗森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一个关于设计之爱及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you.
sentences.zh: 即使在我还在黑胶唱片时代做夜店DJ的时候，你每天晚上都要带着300件你最珍贵的财产去工作。

sentences.en: And you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把DJ台变成了一个充满50年历史精美文物的流动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼的《重构者》吧。

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了吗？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能让你免费试用《时报》一个月，而且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.

sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获取30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So do you guys want to ask me some questions?
sentences.zh: 那么，你们想问我一些问题吗？

sentences.en: Yes, we're going to do this right now.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们现在就要开始。

sentences.en: Let him get in here.
sentences.zh: 让他过来。

sentences.en: Actually, because you're going to do, want to just move to the stand right here?
sentences.zh: 其实，因为你要做……想直接移步到这边的展台吗？

sentences.en: I don't mind doing it.
sentences.zh: 我不介意这样做。

sentences.en: Is that uncomfortable?
sentences.zh: 那样会不舒服吗？

sentences.en: No, it's fine.
sentences.zh: 不，没关系。

sentences.en: Jim Rutenberg is the media columnist for The Times.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·鲁滕伯格是《时报》的媒体专栏作家。

sentences.en: All right, ready?
sentences.zh: 好了，准备好了吗？

sentences.en: Jim.
sentences.zh: 吉姆。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 在。

sentences.en: O'Reilly has been weathering the storm for a really long time.
sentences.zh: 奥莱利在很长一段时间里都经受住了风暴。

sentences.en: He's the number one moneymaker at Fox.
sentences.zh: 他是福克斯最赚钱的人。

sentences.en: The president of the United States defends him.
sentences.zh: 美国总统都在为他辩护。

sentences.en: His ratings are up right now, despite all this.
sentences.zh: 尽管发生了这一切，他的收视率现在还在上升。

sentences.en: Why is he suddenly out of a job now?
sentences.zh: 为什么他突然就失业了呢？

sentences.en: I mean, what clearly happened here is that the parent company, the owner of Fox News, 21st Century Fox,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这里显然发生的事情是，母公司，福克斯新闻的所有者，21世纪福克斯公司，

sentences.en: and the Murdoch family, the controls, it got to a point where they would be saying to their own female staff,
sentences.zh: 以及默多克家族，这些掌权者，已经到了一个地步，他们会对自己的女性员工说，

sentences.en: they would be saying to their shareholders, we hold our profits and our ratings to be more important than a respectable workplace
sentences.zh: 他们会对股东说，我们认为利润和收视率比一个受人尊敬的工作场所更重要，

sentences.en: where women can thrive and feel that they're equal to men.
sentences.zh: 在那里女性可以茁壮成长，并感到自己与男性平等。

sentences.en: And while Fox News kind of celebrates a bygone era where men were men and women were women,
sentences.zh: 虽然福克斯新闻在某种程度上颂扬了一个逝去的时代，那时男人是男人，女人是女人，

sentences.en: you know, there are fewer and fewer people who are ready to accept it to the extent that bad behavior or alleged bad behavior swept under the rug.
sentences.zh: 你知道，越来越少的人愿意接受这种程度的坏行为，或者说被掩盖的所谓坏行为。

sentences.en: But since those factors were always present, and the sins were the same from the beginning until now, what changed inside Fox News?
sentences.zh: 但既然这些因素一直存在，而且从一开始到现在的罪过都是一样的，福克斯新闻内部发生了什么变化？

sentences.en: You've covered this company for a really long time.
sentences.zh: 你报道这家公司已经很长一段时间了。

sentences.en: That explains the reversal from firm defense to see you later, Bill O'Reilly.
sentences.zh: 这解释了从坚定辩护到“再见，比尔·奥莱利”的转变。

sentences.en: There are two explanations.
sentences.zh: 有两种解释。

sentences.en: The nicer, the better explanation for them is that they have a younger generation of Murdochs,
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，更好、更体面的解释是，他们有年轻一代的默多克，

sentences.en: Lachlan and James, Rupert Murdoch's sons, who are the next generation, and they say, Dad, this company cannot withstand this kind of scandal.
sentences.zh: 拉克兰和詹姆斯，鲁珀特·默多克的儿子们，他们是下一代，他们说，爸爸，这家公司经不起这种丑闻。

sentences.en: There's another explanation that the message was less this behavior is unacceptable and more it's unacceptable when you get caught.
sentences.zh: 还有另一种解释，即传达的信息与其说是“这种行为是不可接受的”，不如说是“当你被抓到时，它是不可接受的”。

sentences.en: But how much of this is actually not about genuine outrage from the family or even the outside world, but really just about advertising?
sentences.zh: 但其中有多少实际上并非源于家族甚至外界的真正愤怒，而仅仅是关于广告？

sentences.en: That's a tricky question, too, because Fox has tried to deny that there has been any erosion in their ad dollars,
sentences.zh: 这也是一个棘手的问题，因为福克斯一直试图否认他们的广告收入有任何流失，

sentences.en: even though scores of advertisers left the O'Reilly Factor program.
sentences.zh: 尽管有大量的广告商离开了《奥莱利实情》节目。

sentences.en: What Fox was saying was that those advertisers could get time elsewhere in the network so they didn't ultimately lose the money.
sentences.zh: 福克斯的说法是，这些广告商可以在网络其他地方获得时段，所以他们最终并没有损失这笔钱。

sentences.en: A little bit dubious.
sentences.zh: 有点令人怀疑。

sentences.en: I think it played a factor, but I think this is more about PR or, as they would say, having a better corporate culture.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个因素，但我认为这更多是关于公关，或者正如他们所说的，拥有更好的企业文化。

sentences.en: Quick question, because you know the advertising rule really well.
sentences.zh: 快速问一下，因为你非常了解广告规则。

sentences.en: Why does an advertiser leave a major show like this with such high ratings, even in circumstances like this?
sentences.zh: 为什么广告商会离开像这样收视率如此之高的重要节目，即使是在这种情况下？

sentences.en: What does it take?
sentences.zh: 这需要什么条件？

sentences.en: Well, the phenomenon that was at play here was a social media firestorm.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这里起作用的现象是一场社交媒体风暴。

sentences.en: There was a huge outcry and a lot of pressure brought to bear by several outside groups saying, hey, advertisers, you're endorsing this behavior.
sentences.zh: 有巨大的抗议声，几个外部团体施加了很大的压力，说，嘿，广告商们，你们在纵容这种行为。

sentences.en: And that's a new trend where companies are reacting to that.
sentences.zh: 这是一种新的趋势，公司正在对此做出反应。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: O'Reilly's lawyers say there basically was a liberal activist conspiracy to oust him from his job.
sentences.zh: 奥莱利的律师说，基本上有一个自由派激进分子的阴谋要把他赶出工作岗位。

sentences.en: Is there any truth to that?
sentences.zh: 这有什么真实性吗？

sentences.en: It's laughable.
sentences.zh: 这太可笑了。

sentences.en: You're telling me that Rupert Murdoch and Fox News are going to buckle under pressure from liberal groups?
sentences.zh: 你是说鲁珀特·默多克和福克斯新闻会屈服于自由派团体的压力？

sentences.en: Are you kidding me?
sentences.zh: 你在开玩笑吗？

sentences.en: That's like, it's like everything they stand againSt.
sentences.zh: 这就像是，这就像是他们所反对的一切。

sentences.en: So I just don't buy it.
sentences.zh: 所以我根本不信。

sentences.en: Why did Bill O'Reilly's ratings keep going up during all this?
sentences.zh: 为什么比尔·奥莱利的收视率在这一切过程中一直上升？

sentences.en: That's the part I still find kind of confounding.
sentences.zh: 那是我仍然觉得有点困惑的部分。

sentences.en: Because if you talk to O'Reilly's fans, and I have and do, some of them are my friends, they don't believe it.
sentences.zh: 因为如果你和奥莱利的粉丝交谈，我确实谈过，他们中有些人是我的朋友，他们不相信这些。

sentences.en: This is the MSM going after their guy.
sentences.zh: 这是主流媒体在针对他们的人。

sentences.en: The mainstream media.
sentences.zh: 主流媒体。

sentences.en: The mainstream media.
sentences.zh: 主流媒体。

sentences.en: Going after their star.
sentences.zh: 在针对他们的明星。

sentences.en: And Bill O'Reilly's whole show is don't believe them, and he himself is always under siege and being attacked.
sentences.zh: 而比尔·奥莱利整个节目的核心就是“不要相信他们”，他自己也总是处于被围攻和攻击的状态。

sentences.en: So they're going to take his word over that of the New York Times or any other liberal media outlet in their view.
sentences.zh: 所以他们宁愿相信他的话，也不愿相信《纽约时报》或他们眼中任何其他自由派媒体的话。

sentences.en: And you have a phone call.
sentences.zh: 你有一个电话。

sentences.en: Do you want to take that phone call?
sentences.zh: 你想接那个电话吗？

sentences.en: I can, I'll call it right back.
sentences.zh: 我可以，我待会儿再回过去。

sentences.en: Very quickly, you know how this all plays out on a television network as big as Fox.
sentences.zh: 很快地，你知道这一切在像福克斯这样大的电视网络上是如何上演的。

sentences.en: What are the next 24, 48 hours going to look like?
sentences.zh: 接下来的24到48小时会是什么样子？

sentences.en: How are they going to actually get Bill O'Reilly off television?
sentences.zh: 他们将如何真正让比尔·奥莱利离开电视？

sentences.en: How does the public relations machinery work?
sentences.zh: 公关机制是如何运作的？

sentences.en: That's a huge question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的问题。

sentences.en: Because Bill O'Reilly was the definitional figure of this news network.
sentences.zh: 因为比尔·奥莱利是这个新闻网络的定义性人物。

sentences.en: So I don't think they can do a 1984 style he never existed approach, right?
sentences.zh: 所以我认为他们不能采取那种“1984”式的“他从未存在过”的方法，对吧？

sentences.en: So they're going to have to, they're going to have to somehow honor his legacy without dishonoring themselves by glossing over the reason he left.
sentences.zh: 所以他们必须，他们必须以某种方式尊重他的遗产，同时又不能通过掩盖他离开的原因来损害他们自己的声誉。

sentences.en: All right, finally, this past year, and you covered this campaign alongside me before you went to become the media columnist here,
sentences.zh: 好的，最后，在过去的一年里，在你成为这里的媒体专栏作家之前，你曾和我一起报道过这次竞选，

sentences.en: we saw several versions of pretty much the same story.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了几个几乎相同故事的版本。

sentences.en: A powerful man is accused by a woman or many women of inappropriate behavior, physical or otherwise.
sentences.zh: 一个有权势的男人被一个或多个女人指控有不当行为，无论是身体上的还是其他方面的。

sentences.en: Sometimes it's illegal.
sentences.zh: 有时是违法的。

sentences.en: Sometimes it's right on the bubble.
sentences.zh: 有时是在边缘地带。

sentences.en: Bill Cosby, Roger Ailes, President Trump, and now Bill O'Reilly.
sentences.zh: 比尔·科斯比、罗杰·艾尔斯、特朗普总统，现在是比尔·奥莱利。

sentences.en: Each one of those cases was unique, and they played out uniquely.
sentences.zh: 每一个案例都是独特的，它们的演变方式也各不相同。

sentences.en: And I wonder, given the role you have, what bigger conclusions you're drawing from what we've just seen and what we saw in those cases?
sentences.zh: 我想知道，鉴于你的角色，你从我们刚刚看到的以及我们在那些案例中看到的事情中得出了什么更大的结论？

sentences.en: Well, if you draw the obvious comparison to the one who was affected least by similar allegations, President Trump,
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果你把明显的比较对象指向那个受类似指控影响最小的人——特朗普总统，

sentences.en: it's that corporate America and national television is far less forgiving of these kind of alleged acts than American politics.
sentences.zh: 你会发现，美国企业界和国家电视台对这类所谓行为的宽容度远低于美国政治。

sentences.en: And the American voter.
sentences.zh: 以及美国选民。

sentences.en: Fascinating.
sentences.zh: 太迷人了。

sentences.en: I'm going to use some Tic Tacs just in case I start kissing them.
sentences.zh: 我要吃点薄荷糖，以防我开始亲吻她们。

sentences.en: It's like the tape that showed President Trump with Billy Bush.
sentences.zh: 就像那段显示特朗普总统和比利·布什的录音一样。

sentences.en: It's like kissing them.
sentences.zh: 就像亲吻她们一样。

sentences.en: It's like a magnet.
sentences.zh: 就像磁铁一样。

sentences.en: Making lewd comments about women.
sentences.zh: 对女性发表淫秽评论。

sentences.en: And when you're a star, they let you do it.
sentences.zh: 当你是个明星时，他们会让你这么做。

sentences.en: You can do anything.
sentences.zh: 你可以做任何事。

sentences.en: Whatever you want.
sentences.zh: 任何你想做的事。

sentences.en: Grab them by the pussy.
sentences.zh: 抓住她们的私处。

sentences.en: I can do anything.
sentences.zh: 我可以做任何事。

sentences.en: Was not enough to stop one from getting to the Oval Office, but it was too much for the third hour of the Today Show.
sentences.zh: 这不足以阻止一个人进入椭圆形办公室，但对于《今日秀》的第三小时来说，这太过分了。

sentences.en: Billy Bush was fired from the Today Show, and now Bill O'Reilly has been.
sentences.zh: 比利·布什被《今日秀》解雇了，现在比尔·奥莱利也被解雇了。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Jim, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 吉姆，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: I'm going to let you get back to writing your column.
sentences.zh: 我要让你回去写你的专栏了。

sentences.en: I'm literally crouched here at your desk, and I can see from the look of your screen that you have a little more writing left to go, so I'm going to let you go.
sentences.zh: 我正蹲在你的办公桌旁，从你的屏幕上看，你还有一点没写完，所以我让你走吧。

sentences.en: Don't remind me.
sentences.zh: 别提醒我。

sentences.en: Thanks, Jim.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，吉姆。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: See you.
sentences.zh: 回头见。

sentences.en: Fox News says that starting Monday, Bill O'Reilly's 8 p.m.
sentences.zh: 福克斯新闻表示，从周一开始，比尔·奥莱利晚上8点的时段将由该网络的另一位明星接管，

sentences.en: slot will be taken over by another of the network's stars, the bow-tied conservative provocateur, Tucker Carlson.
sentences.zh: 那位系着领结的保守派煽动者，塔克·卡尔森。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他事情。

sentences.en: A special election in Georgia this week has been treated as national news, seen as an early referendum on President Trump just 90 days into his administration.
sentences.zh: 本周佐治亚州的一次特别选举被视为全国性新闻，被视为特朗普总统执政仅90天后的一次早期公投。

sentences.en: Jonathan Ossoff, a 30-year-old Democrat, was seeking office for the first time in a heavily conservative district.
sentences.zh: 30岁的民主党人乔纳森·奥索夫首次在一个保守派势力强大的选区寻求公职。

sentences.en: We haven't covered the election on this show, in part because we were wary of making too much out of a single race so close to the start of a new presidency.
sentences.zh: 我们没有在这个节目中报道这次选举，部分原因是我们在新总统任期开始之初，对过度解读一场单一的竞选持谨慎态度。

sentences.en: I called my colleague, Jonathan Martin, to see if we had that right.
sentences.zh: 我给我的同事乔纳森·马丁打了电话，看看我们是否理解正确。

sentences.en: So this was an open primary.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一次开放式初选。

sentences.en: So everybody was on the ballot in both parties.
sentences.zh: 所以两个党派的所有人都出现在选票上。

sentences.en: And how the rules work in Georgia, if you got 50 percent plus one, you won the seat outright.
sentences.zh: 在佐治亚州，规则是这样的：如果你获得了50%加一票，你就直接赢得了席位。

sentences.en: If nobody got that, then it would go to a June runoff.
sentences.zh: 如果没有人达到这个比例，那么就会进入6月份的决选。

sentences.en: And so what happened is that Ossoff raised so much money over the last three months from so many national Democrats that he went from just trying to get into the runoff and be a viable major party contender to having a chance to actually clear 50 and win the seat outright.
sentences.zh: 所以发生的情况是，奥索夫在过去三个月里从许多全国民主党人那里筹集了大量资金，以至于他从仅仅试图进入决选并成为一个可行的主要政党竞争者，变成了有机会真正突破50%并直接赢得席位。

sentences.en: A seat that has not been held by a Democrat since the Carter administration, and he nearly did it.
sentences.zh: 这是一个自卡特政府以来从未由民主党人持有的席位，他差点就做到了。

sentences.en: He got 48.1 Tuesday night, falling just short of that threshold to win the seat outright.
sentences.zh: 他在周二晚上获得了48.1%的选票，距离直接赢得席位的门槛仅差一点。

sentences.en: Okay, so everyone paid attention to this special election in Georgia, despite the fact that it was a special election, so therefore a little anomalous,
sentences.zh: 好的，所以每个人都关注了佐治亚州的这次特别选举，尽管它是一次特别选举，因此有点反常，

sentences.en: that it's just one congressional race.
sentences.zh: 这仅仅是一场国会竞选。

sentences.en: And despite all of the flaws that we learned about political prognostication in 2016, I remain skeptical that this race matters.
sentences.zh: 尽管我们在2016年见识到了政治预测的所有缺陷，但我依然怀疑这场竞选是否真的重要。

sentences.en: What do you think?
sentences.zh: 你觉得呢？

sentences.en: Am I wrong?
sentences.zh: 我错了吗？

sentences.en: Too soon to tell.
sentences.zh: 现在下结论还为时过早。

sentences.en: I'll stop for a dodge.
sentences.zh: 我得避而不谈了。

sentences.en: No, but it's the truth, though.
sentences.zh: 不，但这确实是事实。

sentences.en: You're right.
sentences.zh: 你说得对。

sentences.en: There's a reason why they're called special elections.
sentences.zh: 特别选举之所以被称为“特别”，是有原因的。

sentences.en: They're special.
sentences.zh: 它们确实很特别。

sentences.en: They're often quirky.
sentences.zh: 它们往往有些古怪。

sentences.en: There is a history, Michael, of some of these special House races being basically the canary and the coal mine, the political version of the canary and the coal mine.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，这些众议院特别选举在历史上确实曾被视为某种预警信号，也就是政治版的“煤矿里的金丝雀”。

sentences.en: And I can go back for decades, including the Gerald Ford seat in Western Michigan when he left the House to become vice president.
sentences.zh: 我可以追溯到几十年前，包括杰拉尔德·福特在西密歇根州的席位，当时他离开众议院去担任副总统。

sentences.en: A Democrat won that seat, and that was foreboding for the Republicans.
sentences.zh: 民主党人赢得了那个席位，这对共和党人来说是个不祥之兆。

sentences.en: Long history of these special elections telling a story about how the wind is blowing politically.
sentences.zh: 这些特别选举在历史上一直能反映出政治风向。

sentences.en: That said, there are many times where they don't tell us a bigger story about what's happening in American politics.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，很多时候它们并不能反映美国政治大局的走向。

sentences.en: So I think we don't know just yet.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我们现在还不得而知。

sentences.en: But Kansas last week, Georgia this week.
sentences.zh: 但上周是堪萨斯州，这周是佐治亚州。

sentences.en: What is undeniable is that in ruby red parts of America, deeply conservative precincts,
sentences.zh: 不可否认的是，在美国那些深红地区，那些极其保守的选区，

sentences.en: the Democrats in these places are highly energized and are showing up in higher numbers than the Republicans are in those places.
sentences.zh: 民主党人在这些地方表现得非常积极，投票人数比当地的共和党人还要多。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: I'm going to hold you accountable for this.
sentences.zh: 我会让你为此负责的。

sentences.en: I'm going to have you back on during the midterm elections.
sentences.zh: 中期选举时我会再请你来。

sentences.en: We're going to play the tape.
sentences.zh: 到时候我们要回放这段录音。

sentences.en: Play the tape.
sentences.zh: 回放录音。

sentences.en: We're going to go back to the tape, and we're going to see if there was a canary in this coal mine.
sentences.zh: 我们要重温这段录音，看看这到底是不是煤矿里的金丝雀。

sentences.en: Tim Russridge style.
sentences.zh: 蒂姆·拉瑟特风格。

sentences.en: I love it.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢。

sentences.en: I love it.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢。

sentences.en: Jonathan, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 乔纳森，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: See you, man.
sentences.zh: 再见，伙计。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: And in other congressional news, Republican Congressman Jason Chaffetz, the powerful chairman of the House Oversight Committee, said he will not seek re-election.
sentences.zh: 在其他国会新闻方面，共和党众议员、众议院监督委员会强有力的主席杰森·查菲茨表示，他将不再寻求连任。

sentences.en: The Times reports that Chaffetz, who had repeatedly clashed with Hillary Clinton during the campaign, had relished his role overseeing a Democratic-controlled White House,
sentences.zh: 《泰晤士报》报道称，查菲茨在竞选期间曾多次与希拉里·克林顿发生冲突，他很享受自己监督民主党控制的白宫的角色，

sentences.en: not a Republican one.
sentences.zh: 而不是监督共和党控制的白宫。

sentences.en: Finally, after promising as a candidate to tear up President Obama's nuclear deal with Iran.
sentences.zh: 最后，在作为候选人时曾承诺要撕毁奥巴马总统与伊朗达成的核协议之后，

sentences.en: My number one priority is to dismantle the disastrous deal with Iran.
sentences.zh: 我首要的任务就是废除这份与伊朗达成的灾难性协议。

sentences.en: President Trump has notified Congress that Iran is complying with the terms of that agreement, and is making clear that the White House will be standing by the deal,
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统已通知国会，伊朗正在遵守该协议的条款，并明确表示白宫将继续支持该协议，

sentences.en: which requires Iran to give up most of its stockpile of uranium in exchange for the United States and Europe lifting billions of dollars in economic sanctions.
sentences.zh: 该协议要求伊朗放弃大部分铀储备，以换取美国和欧洲解除数十亿美元的经济制裁。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目，我们将为您准备节日待客之道。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，了解如何让您的客人在家中感到宾至如归。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们需要完全黑暗的环境才能入睡吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我指的不是他们是否喝得烂醉才去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物不耐受吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 您可以在《纽约时报》应用程序或您喜欢的任何播客平台上找到《Wirecutter秀》。
